entry.title: Made By AI :: [AI] Scorched SMS: an artillery game for the Sega Master System, inspired by Scorched Earth.
entry.dc:creator: haroldoop
entry.dc:subject: Made By AI
entry.content:
Author: haroldoop
Subject: [AI] Scorched SMS: an artillery game for the Sega Master System, inspired by Scorched Earth.
Posted: Mon Nov 16, 2026 9:45 am (GMT 0)



Scorched SMS --- Technical Overview & Port Summary
================================================

**Scorched SMS** is a full-featured artillery game inspired by Wendell Hicken's 1991 MS-DOS classic *Scorched Earth*, built for the **Sega Master System** in C using **SDCC** and **devkitSMS** (`SMSlib` + `PSGlib`). Packaged into a 48 KB ROM (`scorched.sms`) with zero dynamic bank switching, it supports 2--4 human or CPU tanks competing across destructible per-pixel terrain.

Github repo: https://github.com/haroldo-ok/scorched-sms
Itch.io page: https://haroldo-ok.itch.io/scorched-sms

🎮 Core Gameplay & Arsenal
--------------------------

- **33 Distinct Weapons:**

- **Standard & Nuclear:** Baby Missile (unlimited), Missile, Baby Nuke, Nuke.

- **Multi-Hit & Splitting:** LeapFrog, Funky Bomb, MIRV, Death's Head.

- **Incendiary & Tracing:** Napalm, Hot Napalm, Tracer, Smoke Tracer.

- **Rollers & Riot Payloads:** Baby Roller, Roller, Heavy Roller, Riot Charge, Riot Blast, Riot Bomb, Heavy Riot Bomb.

- **Excavation & Terrain:** 3 tiers of Diggers, 3 tiers of Sandhogs, Dirt Clod, Dirt Ball, Ton of Dirt, Liquid Dirt, Dirt Charge, Earth Disrupter.

- **Energy:** Plasma Blast, Laser.

- **15 Tactical Accessories:**

- **Defenses:** Mag Deflector, Shield, Force Shield (deflects incoming shells), Heavy Shield, Super Mag.

- **Survival & Mobility:** Automatic Parachutes, Repair Batteries (+10 HP), Auto Defense (auto-equips best shield on round start), and Fuel Tanks (enabling tank movement across terrain).

- **Guidance & Triggers:** Heat, Ballistic, Horizontal, and Vertical guidance systems, Lazy Boy auto-aim, and Contact Triggers.

- **Four CPU Skill Tiers:** *Moron*, *Shooter*, *Poolshark*, and *Cyborg*---each simulating physical projectile trajectories (accounting for wind and shields) while scaling accuracy, economy management, and defensive item usage.

- **Atmosphere & Audio:** Dynamic wind (off, static, or variable per turn), speech-bubble tank quips on firing and destruction, and PSG sound effects for launches, falling-shell whistles, explosions, and napalm crackles.

🕹️ Controls & In-Game Arsenal Menu
-----------------------------------

| **Sega Master System Input** | **Action** |
| --- | --- |
| **D-Pad Left / Right** | Adjust turret angle (or drive left/right in Move Mode) |
| **D-Pad Up / Down** | Adjust shot power |
| **Button 1** | Fire weapon / Confirm selection |
| **Button 2** | Open In-Game Arsenal Menu / Back |

*(Controller Port 2 is supported for hot-seat multiplayer.)*

### In-Game Menu Options (Button 2)

- **WEAPON:** Cycle owned ammunition (`Left`/`Right`).

- **GUIDANCE / TRIGGER:** Arm a guidance system or toggle Contact Trigger behavior.

- **SHIELD / BATTERY:** Select and activate defensive shields or restore +10 HP.

- **LAZY BOY:** Select a target tank to automatically calculate turret angle and power.

- **MOVE TANK:** Drive left or right using purchased fuel (1 fuel per pixel; climbing costs extra, steps steeper than 3 pixels block passage, and driving off ledges triggers fall damage unless a parachute deploys).

🏗️ Architecture & Hardware Engineering
---------------------------------------

### Dynamic Tile-Pool Terrain Engine (`src/terrain.c`)

Because the Sega Master System VDP relies on 8×8 background tiles rather than a hardware framebuffer, the playable arena is maintained in RAM as a **256×168 1-bit bitmap** (5,376 bytes):

- **Three-State Cell Classification:** Each 8×8 screen cell resolves to either a shared **All-Sky** tile, a shared **All-Ground** tile, or a dedicated tile allocated from a dynamic **254-slot VRAM pool** for mixed edges, caves, and overhangs.

- **Z80 Assembly Optimization:** Terrain destruction marks affected cells dirty for incremental per-frame VRAM uploads. Tile generation and optional *falling dirt* physics run in hand-written Z80 assembly---delivering roughly **6× the speed** of compiled SDCC C loops. Physics calculations always evaluate against the exact RAM bitmap even if the 254-tile pool saturates.

### Static 48 KB ROM Memory Map

| **Address Range** | **Bank / Region** | **Contents** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `0x0000`--`0x7FFF` | Fixed ROM | `main.c`, `terrain.c`, `weapons.c`, and `SMSlib` runtime |
| `0x8000`--`0xBFFF` | Bank 2 (Permanently Mapped) | `ui.c`, `ai.c`, and generated lookup tables/sprites (`gen.py`) |

*Build verification via `checkmap.py` automatically enforces header boundaries (`0x7FE0`), bank capacity, and RAM headroom.*

🧪 Automated Verification & Known Caveats
-----------------------------------------

- **Headless Emulation Suite:** Validated via `smstest` using scripted test generators (`tests/gen_tests.py`) covering full weapon/accessory coverage (`playtest.txt`, `items2.txt`) and a 3-round, 4-CPU soak test (`soak.txt`).

- **Hardware & Gameplay Notes:**

- Untested on physical Master System hardware.

- High-budget CPU matches run ~5 seconds per turn as AI opponents stack shields and batteries; rounds cap at 200 turns (draw).

- Up to four tanks sharing the same scanline with active shields and parachutes will trigger the VDP's 8-sprites-per-scanline flicker limit.

- AI and Lazy Boy trajectory simulations treat Force Shields as solid targets rather than reflective surfaces.

changelog (since v0.59)

- New playable world: Hi-Tech World (Planet Techo) + final bosses
- New playable world: Cura Cura Castle + boss arena + Count Komori boss
- New darkness effect with reduced visibility around the player in Cura Cura Castle
- New mechanics and animations (inertia on ice, conveyor belts, revolving doors, snowflakes)
- Intro and ending scenes from Bomberman '93, with Bomberman '93 and '94 credits
- New animated title screen
- New HUD
- New Options, Pause, Cheats and Game Over screens
- New animated in-game scenes
- Performance optimizations
- Bug fixes
